WashThru RF-V1 Touchless Automatic Car Wash Machine — Saudi-Made, World-Class Performance

Looking for a touchless automatic car wash machine that protects your vehicle's paint, completes a full wash cycle in under two minutes, and can be managed entirely from your phone? The RF-V1 from WashThru is the answer — manufactured in Saudi Arabia, tested in the harshest Gulf conditions, and engineered to deliver maximum throughput and profitability from day one.

Note: For the complete technical details of the RF-V1 touchless automatic car wash machine, you can download the model's full technical brochure in PDF format here.

Why Touchless Technology in the RF-V1?

Traditional rotating brushes leave fine scratches on a car's paint over time and require constant maintenance of cloths and rollers. The RF-V1 touchless car wash machine relies entirely on high-pressure water and specialized chemicals to remove dirt with zero mechanical contact with the vehicle's surface.

This makes it the ideal choice for customers with premium paint jobs or special finishes. The RF-V1's touchless technology is specifically tuned for vehicles with a moderate level of dirt — the condition of the vast majority of vehicles at daily wash stations.

The Full Wash Cycle in the RF-V1 Touchless Automatic Car Wash Machine

The RF-V1 automatic touchless machine doesn't stop at a surface rinse — it takes every vehicle through a complete, sequential set of stages:

Stage One — Pre-Wash Preparation

The exterior is sprayed with low-pressure water combined with specialized chemicals to break down stubborn dirt and residue before entering the high-pressure stage.

Stage Two — Undercarriage Wash (Optional)

A dedicated stage for cleaning the underside of the chassis and hard-to-reach areas — a professional addition that sets your station apart from competitors.

Stage Three — High-Pressure Wash

24 flat-fan MEG nozzles made of stainless steel spray the vehicle with high-pressure water from the front, rear, top, and sides simultaneously to remove even the most stubborn dirt.

Stage Four — Foam Application

120 ml of specialized soap is dispensed per vehicle, evenly and thoroughly, to deepen the cleaning process and enhance the shine.

Stage Five — Pre-Rinse and Final Rinse

Two consecutive rinse stages; the final rinse uses optional polish/wax that can be pumped from a separate water source to ensure the highest level of cleanliness.

Stage Six — Full Air Drying (Optional)

The RF-V1's wash cycle closes with an advanced drying system that works on every side of the vehicle at once. All of these stages together take an average of just 1.5 to 2 minutes per car.

Full Technical Specifications of the RF-V1 Touchless Car Wash Machine

The RF-V1 touchless automatic car wash machine is designed to accommodate the majority of vehicles common in the Saudi and Gulf markets, including SUVs, sedans, and four-wheel-drive vehicles.

Washable Vehicle Dimensions for the RF-V1

  • Length: up to 5.2 meters
  • Width: up to 2.5 meters including side mirrors
  • Height: up to 2.6 meters
  • Machine weight: 900 kg

Electrical Power Requirements

The RF-V1 runs on three-phase power at 380V and 60Hz, with a maximum consumption of 8 kW, while consumption per vehicle does not exceed 0.4 kWh — one of the lowest power consumption rates in the touchless automatic car wash category.

Water Consumption Efficiency

  • 230 liters per vehicle in standard mode
  • Only 23 liters when the built-in water recycling system is activated

Chemical Consumption per Vehicle

  • Soap: 120 ml
  • Pre-wash chemical: 40 to 50 ml
  • Wax: 60 to 80 ml (optional)

Air Drying System in the RF-V1 Touchless Automatic Car Wash Machine

The RF-V1 is equipped with an integrated drying system consisting of 4 top dryers and 2 side dryers, each rated at 5.5 kW, with a combined airflow of up to 17,400 CFM.

These specifications ensure complete, rapid drying from every angle with no need for manual drying, cutting service time and increasing the number of vehicles processed per hour. Separate air-drying units can be added at the machine's entrance or exit depending on your site's layout.

Specialized Pressure and Pump System

The RF-V1's pumps operate within a safe pressure range of 20 to 24 bar to ensure optimal cleaning results without damaging the vehicle's paint or exterior materials.

An upgrade option to a high-pressure pump reaching 25 bar is available for sites that receive heavily soiled vehicles, in addition to a separate medium-pressure pump (9 bar) dedicated to the undercarriage wash — both made of stainless steel to resist corrosion in the Gulf's humid environments.

Smart Operating Technologies in the RF-V1 Touchless Automatic Car Wash Machine

The RF-V1 isn't limited to traditional washing — it offers a comprehensive smart management system that gives you full control over your station from anywhere. The operating technologies built into the RF-V1 touchless automatic car wash machine include the following:

10 Customizable Wash Programs, Remotely Adjustable

Lets you offer your customers multiple tiers of wash packages and pricing, with the ability to make instant wireless adjustments without needing to visit the site.

Five-Language Operating Interface

The RF-V1's interface supports Arabic, English, Hindi, Bengali, and Urdu, making it easy to operate with any available workforce without extensive training.

Wireless Wi-Fi Control

Access the machine's settings and monitor its performance from any mobile or tablet device, either on-site or remotely through the Wash Cloud platform.

Integration with Electronic Payment Systems

The RF-V1 supports full integration with POS devices and smart payment gateways, including mada, Visa, and Mastercard, with the option to add a dedicated RFID reader for customer loyalty programs and a license plate recognition camera.

Self-Service Mobile App

The RF-V1 supports integration with a driver app for full self-service operation without the need for a reception attendant.

Wireless Vehicle Reports

The RF-V1 keeps a complete historical operating log and lets you review the number of vehicles, their entry times, sizes, and system invoices wirelessly from anywhere.

Safety and Protection System in the RF-V1

The RF-V1 touchless car wash machine is built with multiple layers of automatic protection that ensure continuous operation while protecting both vehicles and operators.

  • Digital and analog pressure sensors to protect against dry running
  • Dual protection system for the top dryers combining infrared and ultrasonic sensors
  • Protection against electrical over- and under-current
  • Phase-sequence sensor ensuring continuous safety at every step
  • A VPN-enabled router securing remote access with the highest encryption standards
  • Automatic partial or full shutdown system upon detecting any fault, with instant notification via SMS, Wi-Fi, or local cable

The Wash Cloud Platform: Beyond the Wash

Wash Cloud is WashThru's proprietary cloud platform built into the RF-V1, representing the qualitative leap from a traditional wash machine to a fully integrated smart station management system.

Wash Cloud uses artificial intelligence to read the performance of the RF-V1's non-consumable parts and estimate their expected lifespan based on precise environmental variables such as temperature, humidity, water salinity, and geographic location, enabling the remote maintenance team to know which parts need replacing before the machine ever stops. The platform also includes:

  • A smart automated assistant that diagnoses unfamiliar faults and proposes likely causes within seconds
  • Troubleshooting guidance via instructional videos, empowering local technicians to make immediate repairs
  • Automatic reporting of any fault on the RF-V1 without requiring manual reporting
  • Automatic SMS alerts as any part approaches the end of its service life
  • Continuous updates to remote control systems to enhance security and improve performance
  • Full cloud storage of the machine's data and reports
  • An API service to connect your ERP systems with the RF-V1 platform for a nominal fee

After-Sales Services: A Two-Year Warranty and More

WashThru doesn't sell an automatic car wash machine and walk away — it delivers a comprehensive support system that begins on installation day and never really ends. Here are WashThru's key after-sales services:

  • Two-year warranty against manufacturing defects on the RF-V1: extendable to a full 5 years, provided you continue with WashThru's approved periodic maintenance services.
  • Genuine spare parts: ready for supply within Saudi Arabia and Libya, minimizing forced downtime and protecting the continuity of your revenue.
  • Multilingual technical support: in Arabic, English, Filipino, and Urdu, ensuring every member of your operating team gets support in their own language regardless of nationality.
  • Augmented reality (AR) support: for cases requiring live visual assistance, where a remote technician sees exactly what you see and guides you directly, without waiting for an on-site visit.
  • Pre-scheduled preventive maintenance visits: to inspect the RF-V1's components and confirm optimal performance before any small issue turns into a full stoppage.
